contributorNote: Taita (Kidawida / Kisagala / Kikasigau) vocabulary compiled from Rev. Dr. J. L. Krapf (1850), Rev. A. Downes Shaw (1885), Rev. W. E. Taylor (1891), Rev. J. Alfred Wray (1894 "An Elementary Introduction to the Taita Language, Eastern Equatorial Africa: Sagalla Dialect", SPCK London), Prof. Alice Werner (1915), Sir Harry H. Johnston (1919 #14), and BFBS (1921). Expanded and cross-verified with Commercially Permissive Datasets (ThinkKenya/Waleghwa Kidaw'ida Parallel Corpus (26,662 pairs, CC-BY-4.0), Mozilla Common Voice 25.0 Kidaw'ida (CC0-1.0), CLDF ASJP v20 TAITA & BantuBVD (CC-BY-4.0)).

entries.english: For God so loved the world (John 3:16 — 1911 Dabida Specimen #477 & 1912 Sagalla Specimen #478)
entries.translation: Dabida (1911): Angu Mlungu oregukundiege wurumwengu, hata ukamfunya Mwana wake uvalwaga wa ititi, uhu umrumiriaga usetote anduangi, ela ukaiege na irangi ja kala na kala. • Sagalla (1912): Kwani hung' Mlungu washaile masanga 'gose, hatta akamfunya Mwana wake avelo mmojori, uu wose amdumusa sehaita, ela apate umaana 'gwa kale na kale.
entries.context: British and Foreign Bible Society (1921) The Gospel in Many Tongues: Specimens of 543 Languages (London — Public Domain)
